rationale: Matches the required structure section-for-section and keeps the three planes separated throughout. FACTS discipline is strong: capabilities labelled [CONFIG]/[EXTEND]/[NEW], unknowns raised as [DECISION], and it catches the deployed-PostgreSQL-is-the-app-DB trap. Isolation, confidential-as-enforced-access-rule, least-privilege sources and fail-closed paths are concretely specified with negative tests. Deductions: work packages have exit gates but no size or effort bounds, tests lack an explicit requirements traceability matrix, and authorization/audit rules repeat across several sections.
